sequence_observed: Opening buzz, peaceful household and first alarm
Failed stillness and complete nose image before It cheated
Lightning, empty bites, blanket paw retrieval and vanity defense
Dead-button pause, spray misfire, immediate care and refused shelter
Charging interval, crouch/open corner and complete showdown image
Miss/miss/sneeze, fan disappearance and air-support claim
Blanket relocation, Closely exchange and complete shared-refuge image
Heather mosquito-net close and entire provenance notes

observations.humor_and_timing: The mosquito nose landing undercuts Buddy stillness immediately; the image freezes his open-mouth alarm before the short It cheated defense. Empty bites contrast with retrieving his exposed paw. The plastic click gets its own readable paragraph, and miss/miss/sneeze supplies three quick descending action beats. Humor remains specific to this nuisance and these dogs.
observations.distinct_voices_and_agency: Neet interprets household equipment as lightning and air support, then saves dignity with inspecting defenses/Closely. Buddy tries stillness, chooses shelter, offers space, and independently moves beneath the fan. Heather escalates equipment, cares for Neet after the accident, and ends with a practical net proposal. The historical Heather-and-dogs household stays intact.
observations.cause_effect_and_payoff: Dead battery motivates the spray attempt; Neet jumping causes the misfire; Heather wipes him before action resumes. Explicit charging pause permits the final racket attempt. Fan victory is acknowledged sheer luck, not an earned combat skill; its useful comic consequence is Neet appropriating credit. The emotionally earned ending is his acceptance of Buddy earlier offered shelter, while Buddy makes the refuge safer by relocating it.

image_state_and_complementarity.observation: Buddy carries the mosquito at his nose with alarmed mouth while Neet watches. Placed after scream and before backing away. It establishes standing characters and a tiny nuisance defeating dignity.

Neet is low in front with raised hindquarters and planted paws, Buddy peeks from blanket, and Heather cropped hand holds racket away from them. Single airborne insect remains. Placement precedes final dives and does not show a premature victory.

Both dogs rest beneath one blanket with distinct paws and relaxed faces, after Neet enters and before Heather returns to couch. Empty couch is correct at this anchor. Fan is outside the low crop; no insect remains. Close framing pays off cooperation rather than repeating combat.

observations.reading_layout: Large readable text, clear phase headings and ample image spacing. Images occur between completed beats, without splitting dialogue attribution. All three are loaded and legible at 960px width. The middle image is taller than one viewport, inspected over overlapping screenshots.
